build_textvqa_dataset: build a TextVQABuilder instance to construct the TextVQA dataset using the default config path
review_config_path: review the TextVQABuilder config_path method to return the defaults YAML path for the textvqa dataset
update_registry_for_model: update the registry with text and answer processor vocab sizes and references for the TextVQA model
register_text_processor: register the text processor and its vocab size in the MMF registry via update_registry_for_model
register_answer_processor: register the answer processor and num final outputs in the MMF registry via update_registry_for_model
